description: Repairs r-def-expr-sql/expr-nonjet-function-names: two entries were wrapped into statements that say nothing about the names. Asks what ACE answers to the two entries that were wrapped as SELECT 1 FROM One AS v FROM One and SELECT * AS v FROM One, run as whole statements: SELECT 1 FROM One, SELECT * FROM One and SELECT COUNT(*) FROM One. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
